objectives: Speak with Dante at the open workshop
Follow the copper caps across Three Arch Bridge
Collect the hearth seed at the foot of the Crown
Bring the hearth seed back to Dante
Fit the seed in the empty furnace clamp
The kiln is lit. Malik wears Dante's ember clasp.
outbound: Hear that? A cold kiln. The quake pulled our hearth seed back into the Split Crown.
See the copper caps on the bridge? Follow them. The three brass collars on the far slope are holding the seed.
Wait out the blue wave. Then fire Sunbolt into the amber faces. Bring me the seed and we can relight this place.
homecoming: There it is. Still warm, even after the crossing. Hold the clamp steady, Malik.
Fit the seed beside my anvil. When the bellows catch, this ember clasp is yours.
